title: Garage dimensions, opening and vehicle clearance
inputs: Capture reviewed donor mesh bounds or orthogonal ruler observations
Measure door opening width and height at the narrowest usable section
Record wall-to-wall spans, usable height, workbench anchor and coordinate space
expected: Garage anchor and roof envelope remain traceable to existing records
Door opening and interior dimensions receive source, evidence and tolerance
Vehicle-clearance conclusion names the tested vehicle configuration
toleranceNotes: Serialized transforms target 5 mm absolute tolerance. Manual screen/ruler measurements must declare pixel or marker uncertainty explicitly.
